mappings.name: Spoofing
mappings.description: Lack of origin validation lets a malicious webpage spoof a legitimate local client.

mappings.name: Information Disclosure
mappings.description: Exfiltration of API keys, logs, configuration, and device list once the session is hijacked.

mappings.name: Elevation of Privilege
mappings.description: Auto-approved device registration grants the attacker's page a trusted device identity with no user confirmation.
